content.text: KAWASANA OPU apakaro kotana i bhawona tubuna gunu momangkilo.
KAWASANA OPU amaasiaka bhambana lawana Sion
alabhi minaaka i bhari-bharia tampa mosagaanana modhaangiana i Israel, lipuna Yakub.
Manga mia apogauakako tee giu momulia,
tee Babel i tanga-tangana lipu momatauaku.
Tee uka o Tana Filistin, Tirus tee Etiopia,
'Manga incia sii uka atoabhi amembali raʼeatina Sion.' "
Maka to Sion, manga mia bheapogau, "Mia incia sii tee mia incia sumai alaahiri i nuncana,
tee o Aulataʼala Momalangana sakaro-karona bhemopekatangkea."
KAWASANA OPU bhealentua wakutuuna daftaraana manga lipu,
"Manga incia sii uka aabhia o raʼeatina Sion." Sela
Apoose amanari, manga mia bhealagu, "Minaaka i Sion ingkita tatarima manga giu momalape
mboomo mia momboorena i saripina matana uwe."

footnotes.text: Rahab: Saro mosagaanana to asarongiaka Mesir mokomaʼanana "asombo."
Manga lipu moparacaeana tee Kawasana Opu bheatolentu mboomo mia molaahirina i Sion (kota Yerusalem), tee mboo sumai manga incia apesua i nuncana uumatina Aulataʼala.
